queue.title: Review queue

empty.title: No cases are waiting for review
empty.body: The queue fills when an escalation rule fires on a couple's case. Every rule and its source is listed on the governance page.

queue.meta: {count} open · sorted by priority, then waiting

brief.title: Brief

notice.title: A decision aid, not clinical advice
notice.body: This brief supports the counsellor's conversation and does not replace a clinician's judgement. Its rules and wording are pending sign-off by the clinical lead (sign-off pending).

detection.title: Detection statements
detection.none: No detection statement is listed in this brief.
detection.caveat: These partners are related. A negative test reassures less for related partners than for unrelated ones, because the same change can be missed in both. No figure is shown for that.

referrals.title: Referral tasks
referrals.caption: Referral tasks for this couple
referrals.none: No referral task has been created yet.

brief.partial: The proforma form could not be loaded, so only the brief is shown.
brief.empty: Select a case from the queue. The brief and its trace open here.
brief.partialPathway: The pathway could not be loaded, so no action is offered.

section.why: Why a human is asked to look

brief.englishNote: Rule text and sources are in English.

proforma.title: Closure proforma
proforma.standfirst: Twelve fields in the order of the form. The system fills what it already knows, the clinician completes the clinical fields, and the patient answers their own part separately.
proforma.systemValue: Recorded by the system when the form is saved
proforma.patientNote: Completed by the patient in their own session. Not editable here.

validation.datetime: Enter a valid date and time.
validation.choice: Choose one of the listed options.
validation.actionRow: Complete the action, owner and due date, or remove the row.
validation.atLeastOne: Complete at least one field before saving.

success.title: Proforma saved
success.body: The record was stored for this couple.

error.title: The proforma could not be saved
error.body: Nothing was stored. Check the messages next to the fields, then try again.

trace.title: Trace
trace.empty: Select a case to see the rule, source and sign-off behind each line.
trace.footer: Nothing in this brief is generated. Each line comes from a rule, a record or the engine, and links to it.
trace.englishNote: Rule text and sources are in English.

action.none: No pathway step can be recorded here right now.
action.error: That step could not be recorded
action.label: Actions

haem.title: Haematology work-up reading
haem.standfirst: Enter the blood count first, then the HPLC result. The aid reads the values against written rules and shows every rule it used. It does not decide anything.

boundary.title: Read this first
boundary.statement: Not a diagnosis. A decision aid for the clinician.
boundary.owner: The rules and wording are pending sign-off by the clinical lead (sign-off pending).
boundary.synthetic: Synthetic demo: enter made-up values only. No real patient data.

cbc.hint: This step can be submitted on its own.

hplc.hint: Optional. Submitting it reads the CBC and the HPLC together.

haem.unansweredHint: A question left as Not answered is not sent. The aid reads it as not known and never fills it in.

age_years.label: Age
age_years.hint: Without an age the aid reports the blood count as incomplete.

transfused_last_4_months.label: Blood transfusion in the last 4 months
transfused_last_4_months.hint: A recent or unknown transfusion makes the blood count inconclusive for this aid.

ferritin_status.label: Ferritin flag from the laboratory
ferritin_status.hint: The aid uses the laboratory's own flag, not a number.

hba2_is_total.label: HbA2 is the total HbA2
hba2_is_total.hint: Check that the HbA2 value above is the total, including any HbA2 variant peak.

single_hba_band_only.label: Single major peak in the HbA position
single_hba_band_only.hint: The written rules apply only when a single major peak is in the HbA position.

result.title: Reading

empty.title: Enter the CBC first, then the HPLC
empty.body: Start with the complete blood count. A CBC alone can never give a carrier statement. The HPLC comes second and is optional. The reading appears here with every rule it used.

basedOn.both: Based on the CBC and the HPLC

result.stale: The values have changed since this reading. Interpret again to update it.
result.statement: Not a diagnosis. A decision aid for the clinician.

callout.title: Needs clinician sign-off
callout.body: The rules behind this reading are pending sign-off by the clinical lead (sign-off pending). A clinician looks at the reading before anything is done with it.

error.title: The values could not be interpreted
error.body: No reading was produced. Check the values, then try again.

label.pattern_suggests_possible_compound_or_af: Pattern suggests possible compound or affected
label.pattern_unclear_refer_for_molecular: Pattern unclear, refer for molecular testing
label.no_pattern_flagged_on_this_work_up: No pattern flagged on this work-up
